statements_full: Healthcare workers should implement standard precautions, which include hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, appropriate PPE based on risk assessment, safe injection practices, sharps management, waste management, cleaning of linens, environmental cleaning, and disinfection of patient care equipment.
When caring for patients with respiratory symptoms, healthcare workers should use a medical mask and eye protection to prevent transmission via respiratory droplets.

For patients with suspected respiratory infection, healthcare workers should use contact precautions, wearing a long-sleeved gown and gloves, and perform hand hygiene before and after patient contact.
During aerosol-generating procedures, healthcare workers should wear gloves, long-sleeved gowns, eye protection, and a fit‑tested respirator such as an N95 or equivalent.
Healthcare workers should practice hand hygiene frequently and avoid touching their eyes, nose, and mouth with contaminated hands.
When performing aerosol-generating procedures, healthcare workers should use a negative‑pressure room with adequate ventilation (minimum 6–12 air changes per hour) to reduce airborne transmission.

Droplet precautions prevent transmission of respiratory viruses through respiratory droplets that are expelled when an infected person speaks, coughs, or sneezes.

Les interventions comprennent l'évaluation cognitive de l'image corporelle, la thérapie cognitivo-comportementale, l'évaluation de la douleur, la gestion médicamenteuse (amitriptyline), les soins de la peau, les soins des plaies, les pansements rigides, l'évaluation cardiovasculaire, les exercices de mobilité et le contrôle de l'oedème.

La rééducation est un service de santé essentiel pour les personnes ayant subi une amputation, quel que soit l'âge ou la localisation de l'amputation, afin d'atteindre et de maintenir un fonctionnement optimal et une indépendance.
